comments.text: EEE499A totally luck velky luck. 1st session a advising thakleo Khali pawa mushkil. And choose EEE based faculties and those jara publication koray. 499 a CSE and EEE ratio is like 35:5. So group koreo ek sathe section neya tough. But group chara nile trust me baje level er mara khawar chance ase. And some faculties take 499B and 498 together. Thats easier. But other than that 498R tough eee courses er sathe na neya better. Cuz you gotta put a lot of time in research, self study and more for 499 and 498. So choose accordingly. And 499 a group kore ek faculty pawa onk boro luck er bepar. Na mille pera.
